description: This file defines an abstract class SynthUnit related to MIDI synthesis, providing a method to convert MIDI pitch to frequency and serving as a base class for synthesizer units.

classes.name: SynthUnit
classes.description: Abstract class representing a synthesis unit with utility method for pitch-to-frequency conversion.

methods.name: pitchToFrequency
methods.description: Converts a MIDI pitch value in semitones to a frequency in Hz.
